::: {#exr-weights}

#### A weighted average chosen by the input

Take the query $\vq = (1, 0)$ and three keys with one value each:

| Key | Value |
|-----|------:|
| $(2, 0)$ | 10 |
| $(0, 2)$ | 20 |
| $(1, 1)$ | 30 |

Score each key by its [dot product](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-vectors.html#def-dot-product) with $\vq$,
turn the three scores into weights with the [softmax](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/multiclass-logistic-regression.html#def-softmax),
and give the weighted average of the values.

:::
